rationale: Both languages passed all 17 acceptance cases and 43 checks. The Guion median was 0.015355 seconds versus Python at 0.084636 seconds, about 5.5 times faster, and the deterministic JSON audit fits the task.
task: Build a command-line audit of a software bill of materials against a team policy, reporting disallowed packages, version limits, and exceptions in deterministic JSON.
trial_observation: Seven randomized pairs: Guion 0.015355s, Python 0.084636s; ratio 0.181 (about 5.5x faster for the named case). Both passed 17/17 cases and 43/43 checks. Candidate/previous Guion ratio 1.053 (95% interval 0.992–1.095).
caveat: The selected related task is not the exact frozen lockfile-auditor task. The candidate/previous-build timing interval crosses parity, so no speed improvement is established for this app.
